hunks.baseline: [^1]: In East Asian lore, a dragon’s “reverse scale” is a uniquely dangerous vulnerable spot; touching it is said to provoke the dragon’s rage.
hunks.sol: [^1]: The Korean expression invokes a dragon’s “reverse scale,” a spot that must not be touched because doing so provokes its rage.
